fields.tagline: “agent factory”: a requester describes an agent in plain language, and Forge specifies, builds, deploys it to Azure AI Foundry and evaluates it.
fields.description: Forge is an agent that builds agents. A requester describes a need in plain language, and Forge converts it into a specified, built, deployed, and evaluated agent on Azure AI Foundry. When a full agent is not required, Forge produces a reusable skill. Specialist agents are coordinated by a deterministic Orchestrator and a standardized deployment engine. Every stage reads from and writes to a shared Agent Spec, creating a complete record of the request, build, deployment, and evaluation.
fields.business_value: A standardized and scalable approach that enables faster agent delivery through consistency, governance, reuse, and traceable quality standards.
fields.cta_headline: Let's build your first agent factory
